verdict.rationale: llamafile ships an HTTP server with an API and Web UI (docs-9, docs-5), which is the kind of local backend a coding agent could in principle target, but the evidence never mentions OpenAI-API compatibility, any named coding agent (e.g. Continue, Aider, Cursor), or a documented integration/config example for agent use. missing for 10: explicit OpenAI-compatible API documentation, named coding-agent integrations, and hands-on evidence of an agent successfully using llamafile as its backend.
